case.message: Do you have any books by Mercer Mayer?

expect.outcome: Lists Mercer Mayer books (5 in the catalogue).

task_plan.description: Search the library catalogue for books by Mercer Mayer

final.answer:
Yes, we have several books by Mercer Mayer. Here are a few titles you might be interested in:

1. "Little Critter: Just a Snowman" (2012)
2. "Little Critter: Just a School Project" (2004)
3. "Bye-Bye, Mom and Dad" (2004)
4. "Little Critter: Good for Me and You" (2004)
5. "Little Critter: My Trip to the Hospital" (2005)

Please note that the availability of these books may vary. If you're interested in borrowing any of them, I can check their current status for you.

lexical_results.title: Little Critter: Just a Snowman
lexical_results.author: Mercer Mayer
lexical_results.description: Join Mercer Mayer’s classic and beloved character, Little Critter®, on his snow day! Snow is piled high and school is cancelled. But before Little Critter can build his snowman, he must help his sister wear her snow boots, his dad shovel the sidewalk, and Gator build a fort. Will Little Critter...

lexical_results.title: Little Critter: Just a School Project
lexical_results.author: Mercer Mayer
lexical_results.description: Little Critter studies caterpillars as his project for the science fair.

lexical_results.title: Bye-Bye, Mom and Dad
lexical_results.author: Mercer Mayer
lexical_results.description: Little Critter thinks he is in charge when Mom and Dad go away for the day even though Grandma and Grandpa spend the day with him.

lexical_results.title: Little Critter: Good for Me and You
lexical_results.author: Mercer Mayer
lexical_results.description: At school, Little Critter learns all about having a healthy lifestyle—from a balanced diet and the food pyramid to exercises that keep him in shape. Now Little Critter can showhis family how to stay fit and have fun doing it!

lexical_results.title: Little Critter: My Trip to the Hospital
lexical_results.author: Mercer Mayer
lexical_results.description: When Little Critter breaks his leg in a soccer game, he has to make his first trip to the hospital. Follow brave Little Critter as he rides in an ambulance, meets the doctor, and gets his first X-ray and his first cast.
